The development model

More Than Repetition.

Blending proven European training methodology with a modern, high-performance approach to player development, each session is designed to develop Mindset, refine Technique, and elevate Game IQ — creating confident players who make better decisions, perform under pressure, and maximize their potential on the field.

01

Mindset

Build ownership, resilience, competitiveness, and the confidence to keep making decisions when the game gets uncomfortable.

02

Technique

Develop cleaner touches, sharper passing, stronger striking, purposeful dribbling, and repeatable movement at game-real speed.

03

Soccer IQ

Learn to scan, recognize space, understand options, and make better decisions before pressure arrives.

Carsten Doerfer
The coach behind the work

European Roots. Modern Player Development.

My goal is to provide a player-centered coaching approach, honest feedback that helps players recognize and make adjustments, and the individual attention they often cannot get in a team environment—while connecting their technical development to the decisions and demands they face on match day.
